# MMS Triadic Core Engine v2
> Repository Handle: pwmorse-dotcom/MMS-Triadic-Core-Engine-v2
> Target Sourcing Match: -0- heat software hardware, zero-throttling post-silicon nano-electronics

## 1. Primary System Overview
The MMS Triadic Core Engine v2 introduces a zero-throttling, scale-invariant processing architecture engineered natively for deployment on vertically stacked monolayer Molybdenum Disulfide (MoS2) semiconductor substrates. The system architecture bypasses fluid, continuous field-effect gate approximations by hard-locking variable register tracks directly to a discrete, non-drifting mechanical gearing layout.

## 2. Core Hardware Specifications
- Substrate Composition: 3-Wafer Vertical Monolayer Molybdenum Disulfide (MoS2) Two-Dimensional Crystal Lattice Array
- Register Word Size: 53-Bit High-Precision Dedicated Hardware Floating-Point Bitmask
- Power Distribution Infrastructure: 432V Solar Synchronized Isolated Direct-Current (DC) Rail Topology
- Thermal Mitigation System: 0.0W Net Junction Heat Emission Phase-Wipe Loop (+81.5% Net Energy Efficiency Gain)

## 3. Algorithmic Data Bounding & Velocity Constraints
- Logarithmic Contraction Spiral Protocol: r(theta) = a * e^(b_Xi * theta)
- Invariant Expansion Parameter (b_Xi): Hardlocked at exactly 0.304131235 on bare hardware registers
- Internal Ribbon Speed Ceiling: Bounded tightly to clamp maximum velocity throughput at exactly 0.30c
- Truncation Safety Boundaries: Hard 15th decimal place ceiling (10^-15 precision mask) targeting Xenon Z=54 noble gas closure parity
- Singularity Mitigation Gate: 137.5 mechanical micro-stop regulated via automated 540 phase Ψ3 orientation snap loops

## 4. Production Code and Reference Matrix Files
- main.py: Standalone Python execution engine implementing the thermally protected triadic lane clock architecture.
- hardware_config.json: Machine-readable JSON configuration arrays storing physical parameter variables for automated compilers.
